# HireAI

> HireAI is a free, open, vendor-neutral directory of HR AI products, from 1990s applicant tracking systems to 2024+ agentic AI platforms.

HireAI helps HR leaders, recruiters, vendors, and researchers compare HR technology. It publishes product descriptions, capability tags, evaluation checklists, and analysis pages. HireAI does not sell placements, accept paid rankings, or score vendors.

On 28 September 2026 every product page was refreshed. A briefing states the directory record, the technology era, and checks to verify in a demo. Speed, database size, and conversion figures on product pages are vendor-reported unless the page says otherwise.

The directory currently lists {{ site.data.products.size }} technology eras. Canonical site: {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/

## Key answers

- What is HireAI? A free directory of HR AI products with analysis pages and evaluation checklists.
- What is HR AI? Software that uses machine learning, natural language processing, or autonomous agents for recruiting, assessment, onboarding, learning, and talent management.
- How do I choose a product? Filter by tag, read the analysis, then use that tag's evaluation checklist. HireAI does not rank vendors.
- What is an agentic AI platform for HR? Software that can plan and carry out multi-step talent workflows with limited human intervention. HireAI files these products in the 2024+ era.

## Primary pages

- [Home]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/): Definition of HireAI, era framework, featured analysis, and tags.
- [Product directory]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/product-directory/): Full catalog grouped by technology era. Search with ?q=
- [Tags]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/tags/): Capability index. Tag pages include evaluation checklists.
- [FAQ]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/FAQ/): Answers about the directory, updates, citation, and data access.
- [Flagship analysis]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/hr-ai-evolution-comprehensive-analysis/): Evolution of HR AI from applicant tracking to agentic intelligence.
- [JSON catalog]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/products.json): Machine-readable list of products, tags, eras, websites, and analysis URLs.
- [RSS]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/feed.xml): Recently updated analysis pages.

## Citation

Cite the specific page. Example: HireAI. "Eightfold.ai." {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/eightfold-ai-analysis/.
